name: HCL
summary: HashiCorp Configuration Language provides blocks, attributes and expressions for structured configuration; tools such as Terraform define their own semantics on top.
lifecycleNote: HashiCorp HCL implementation published v2.25.0 on 2026-09-15.

name: HLSL
summary: HLSL is a C-like shader language for DirectX, used to write graphics pipeline stages and compute shaders executed by programmable GPU hardware.
lifecycleNote: Microsoft DirectX Shader Compiler published v1.9.2609 on 2026-09-29.

name: Hack
summary: Hack is an object-oriented language built for the HHVM runtime, using static type checking, generics and asynchronous operations for web applications.
lifecycleNote: The Hack project explicitly states that Hack and HHVM are in active development with frequent releases.

name: Hare
summary: Hare is a statically typed systems language with manual memory management and a minimal runtime, intended for system tools and other low-level software.
lifecycleNote: The Hare toolchain lists version 0.26.0 released in February 2026.

name: Haskell
summary: Haskell is a purely functional language with lazy evaluation, immutable values and a strong type system, using functions and algebraic data types to model programs.

name: Haxe
summary: Haxe is a strictly typed language with a cross-compiler targeting platforms such as JavaScript, C++, JVM and Lua, supporting shared code across application targets.
lifecycleNote: The Haxe compiler lists version 4.3.7 released in May 2025 and a 5.0 preview from July 2025.

name: Hy
summary: Hy is a Lisp dialect embedded in Python, providing alternative syntax and Lisp features while retaining direct access to Python built-ins and third-party libraries.
lifecycleNote: Hy implementation published 1.3.1 on 2026-07-31.

name: Idris
summary: Idris supports type-driven development with first-class types, allowing types to express relationships between values and to guide construction of programs and proofs.
lifecycleNote: Idris 2 published v0.8.0 on 2025-10-31.

name: Imba
summary: Imba compiles to JavaScript and integrates DOM tags and styling into its syntax for building browser interfaces and Node.js applications.

name: Inform 7
summary: Inform 7 describes interactive-fiction worlds and rules using natural-language-style source text, supporting stories, narrative prototypes and teaching.

name: Io
summary: Io is a prototype-based dynamic language in which expressions are messages and objects are cloned; its VM can be embedded in WebAssembly hosts.
lifecycleNote: The Io project documents its VM and WASM/WASI implementation update dated 2026-04-20.

name: J
summary: J is an array-oriented general-purpose language whose operations work on whole arrays, with an interactive environment for mathematical and data-oriented programs.
lifecycleNote: J compiler implementation released build96 on 2025-03-06.

name: JSONiq
summary: JSONiq is a query language for selecting, aggregating and transforming JSON data, with implementations such as RumbleDB for local and distributed processing.
lifecycleNote: The language's official site identifies RumbleDB as its fully supported recommended implementation.

name: Jai
summary: Jai is Jonathan Blow's programming-language project for game development, with compiler design and language features demonstrated in the creator's presentations.

name: Janet
summary: Janet combines functional and imperative programming in an embeddable runtime, with closures, macros and facilities for system scripting.
lifecycleNote: Janet implementation released v1.42.1 on 2026-09-11.

name: Java
summary: Java is a statically typed, object-oriented language supported by the Java virtual machine and extensive standard APIs, including collections, concurrency and networked application facilities.
lifecycleNote: OpenJDK's JDK 27 reference implementation reached general availability on 15 September 2026.

name: JavaScript
summary: JavaScript is a dynamically typed language with prototype-based objects and first-class functions. Browsers expose DOM APIs, while runtimes such as Node.js provide server and file-system facilities.
lifecycleNote: Node.js reports current v26 releases and supported v24/v22 LTS branches, with updates in September and October 2026.

name: Jolie
summary: Jolie models services, message interfaces and orchestration workflows directly in the language, with communication that can use different network protocols.
lifecycleNote: Jolie implementation released v1.12.8 on 2026-03-01.

name: Jsonnet
summary: Jsonnet extends JSON with functions, variables and object composition, producing configuration data without side effects rather than executing deployment actions.
lifecycleNote: Jsonnet implementation released v0.22.0 on 2026-03-24.

name: Julia
summary: Julia is a dynamically typed language built around multiple dispatch and native-code compilation, with interactive tooling and libraries for numerical, scientific and general application work.
lifecycleNote: The Julia implementation published version 1.13.1 on 26 September 2026.

name: KCL
summary: KCL is a schema-based configuration language for defining data structures, validating configuration and generating infrastructure configuration from reusable models.
lifecycleNote: KCL implementation released v0.13.1 on 2026-10-07.

name: Koka
summary: Koka is a statically typed functional language whose effect types and handlers describe operations such as state, exceptions and asynchronous computations.
lifecycleNote: The Koka project explicitly describes v3 as a research language under development and not ready for production use.

name: Kotlin
summary: Kotlin is a programming language with Java interoperability and multiplatform tooling, used for Android applications, server software and shared application code.
lifecycleNote: Kotlin implementation released v2.4.21 on 2026-10-08.

name: LabVIEW
summary: LabVIEW programs use the graphical G language and dataflow diagrams to acquire measurements, control instruments and build automated test systems.
lifecycleNote: NI's release-notes index lists LabVIEW 2026 Q3 and 2026 Q1 product releases.

name: Lean
summary: Lean combines an interactive theorem prover with a dependently typed programming language; its current Lean 4 implementation supports proofs and executable programs.
lifecycleNote: Lean 4 implementation released v4.34.1 on 2026-09-24.

name: Lean 4
summary: Lean 4 reimplements the Lean theorem prover in Lean, combining extensible proof automation with a functional language and native-code compilation.
lifecycleNote: Lean 4 implementation released v4.34.1 on 2026-09-24.

name: LilyPond
summary: LilyPond turns a text-based music notation language into engraved scores, supporting orchestral parts, tablature and other structured notation.
lifecycleNote: The LilyPond project announced stable 2.26.0 on 2026-04-21 and development 2.27.3 on 2026-09-10.

name: LiveScript
summary: LiveScript compiles to JavaScript and adds features such as pattern matching, comprehensions and concise functions for functional and imperative programming.

name: Logtalk
summary: Logtalk extends Prolog with objects, protocols and reusable categories, organising declarative logic programs while using Prolog implementations as backends.
lifecycleNote: The Logtalk project published release 3.102.0 on 2026-09-14.

name: Lua
summary: Lua is an embeddable, dynamically typed scripting language with table-based data structures and bytecode execution, often used to configure or extend a host application.
lifecycleNote: PUC-Rio's Lua team explicitly identifies itself as the language's designers, implementers and maintainers; its page was updated in October 2026.

name: Luau
summary: Luau extends Lua-style scripting with gradual types and an embeddable runtime, supporting host-controlled application scripting and Roblox development.
lifecycleNote: Luau implementation released 0.742 on 2026-10-10.

name: MATLAB
summary: MATLAB is a language and numeric computing environment for developing algorithms, analysing data and visualising results in engineering and science.
lifecycleNote: MathWorks announced MATLAB R2026b released on 2026-09-23.

name: MQL4
summary: MQL4 is MetaTrader 4's language for Expert Advisors, scripts and custom indicators, giving programs access to market quotes and trading-order operations.

name: MQL5
summary: MQL5 is MetaTrader 5's C++-style language for trading robots, technical indicators and utility programs that interact with the trading platform.

name: Mercury
summary: Mercury combines logic and functional programming with static types, modes and determinism checking to build modular declarative applications.
lifecycleNote: The Mercury project announced compiler release 22.01.9 on 2026-08-30.

name: Metal
summary: Metal's shading language defines GPU graphics and compute functions for Apple's Metal API, covering rendering shaders and parallel computation on Apple platforms.

name: MiniZinc
summary: MiniZinc is a high-level constraint modelling language for expressing discrete optimisation problems independently of the particular solver used to solve them.
lifecycleNote: MiniZinc implementation released 2.10.1 on 2026-08-31.

name: Modelica
summary: Modelica describes physical systems with mathematical equations and reusable connected components, supporting simulations of mechanical, electrical and other systems.

name: Modula-2
summary: Modula-2 separates interfaces from implementation in modules and includes facilities for systems programming; GNU Modula-2 supports PIM and ISO dialects.

name: Modula-3
summary: Modula-3 is a modular systems language with objects, exceptions, threads and garbage collection, implemented by the Critical Mass Modula-3 toolchain.
lifecycleNote: Critical Mass Modula-3 implementation released d5.12.0 on 2026-03-27.

name: Mojo
summary: Mojo is a systems programming language for CPU and GPU code, combining readable syntax with memory management controls and compile-time metaprogramming.
lifecycleNote: The Mojo project lists stable 1.1.0 dated September 17 and a nightly dated October 9 on its current release page.

name: MoonBit
summary: MoonBit is a statically typed general-purpose language and toolchain with native and WebAssembly targets, algebraic data types and pattern matching.
lifecycleNote: The MoonBit project announced moonc compiler v0.10.14 on 2026-09-21.

name: MoonScript
summary: MoonScript is a dynamic language with indentation-based syntax and classes that compiles to Lua, allowing existing Lua libraries and hosts to be reused.
lifecycleNote: MoonScript implementation released v0.7.0 on 2026-07-26.

name: Motoko
summary: Motoko is a language for Internet Computer canister applications, with actors, asynchronous calls and persistent data integrated into its programming model.
lifecycleNote: Motoko implementation released 2.0.0 on 2026-10-06.

name: Move
summary: Move represents assets as resources with controlled ownership and transfer, providing modules and transaction logic for blockchain applications.

name: Nemerle
summary: Nemerle is a statically typed .NET language combining functional, object-oriented and imperative code with macros for extending compilation and embedding DSLs.

name: Nextflow
summary: Nextflow expresses computational workflows as processes connected by dataflow channels, running pipelines across local, cluster and cloud execution environments.
lifecycleNote: Nextflow implementation released v26.04.7 on 2026-10-08.

name: Nim
summary: Nim is a statically typed compiled language with indentation-based syntax and compile-time macros. Its back ends produce C, C++ or JavaScript for native and browser applications.
lifecycleNote: The Nim team announced stable compiler version 2.2.12 on 8 September 2026.

name: Nix
summary: Nix is a lazy functional language for describing packages and configurations, used by the Nix tools to evaluate build recipes and development environments.

name: Nushell
summary: Nushell is a cross-platform shell language whose pipelines carry structured values and tables, supporting data transformation and system automation.
lifecycleNote: Nushell implementation released 0.116.1 on 2026-10-04.

name: OCaml
summary: OCaml is a statically typed functional language with pattern matching, modules and garbage collection, offering both native and bytecode compilation for application and language-tool development.
lifecycleNote: The OCaml project reports compiler version 5.5.1 on 5 September 2026 and an available 4.14 LTS series.

name: Oberon
summary: Oberon is a compact modular language developed with the Oberon operating system, extending Pascal-style records to support extensible systems and applications.

name: Objective-C
summary: Objective-C adds object-oriented messaging to C and is used by existing Cocoa applications. Its APIs and language conventions connect C code to the Objective-C runtime.
lifecycleNote: GCC lists an Objective-C front end and a supported 16.2 compiler release from 7 August 2026; this does not describe Apple's SDK lifecycle.

name: Objective-J
summary: Objective-J extends JavaScript with Objective-C-style classes and message syntax, and is used with Cappuccino to build desktop-style applications in the browser.

name: Odin
summary: Odin is a compiled general-purpose language focused on systems and data-oriented programming, with explicit memory allocators and support for array operations.
lifecycleNote: Odin implementation released dev-2026-10 on 2026-10-06.

name: OpenCL
summary: OpenCL provides a kernel programming language and APIs for running parallel computations across CPUs, GPUs and other accelerators in heterogeneous systems.

name: OpenQASM
summary: OpenQASM describes quantum circuits and their classical control flow, acting as an intermediate representation between quantum compilers and hardware.

name: OpenSCAD
summary: OpenSCAD describes solid 3D objects with scripts and configurable parameters, rendering models from geometric operations rather than interactive drawing.

name: Oz
summary: Oz is the language implemented by the Mozart programming system, combining declarative computation, concurrency and constraint-oriented programming.
lifecycleNote: The Mozart 2 implementation's official repository describes it as alpha quality and not ready for production.

name: P4
summary: P4 describes packet headers, parsing and forwarding actions for programmable network data planes, with compilers that target particular hardware or software switches.
lifecycleNote: p4c implementation released v1.2.5.18 on 2026-10-02.

name: PHP
summary: PHP executes scripts on the server to generate web responses and also provides a command-line interpreter, with procedural and object-oriented facilities and database extensions.
lifecycleNote: The PHP team announced supported-branch security releases, including PHP 8.5.11, on 24 September 2026.

name: Pascal
summary: Pascal is a structured procedural language originating in Niklaus Wirth's work at ETH, with descendants and compilers supporting applications and programming education.

name: Perl
summary: Perl is a general-purpose scripting language with regular expressions, text-processing facilities and a large module ecosystem, used in automation, web applications and database integration.

name: PicoLisp
summary: PicoLisp is a data-oriented Lisp system integrating a language, persistent object database and web interface facilities for building applications.

name: Pony
summary: Pony is a compiled actor-model language using reference capabilities to govern object sharing and mutation, with asynchronous actors and native C interoperability.
lifecycleNote: ponyc implementation released 0.75.0 on 2026-10-11.

name: PowerShell
summary: PowerShell combines an object-oriented command shell, scripting language and configuration tools. Commands pass structured .NET objects through pipelines for system and cloud automation.
lifecycleNote: The PowerShell implementation published version 7.6.6 on 8 September 2026.

name: Processing
summary: Processing is a programming language and environment for visual arts, using sketch-style programs to create graphics, animation and interactive projects.
lifecycleNote: Processing implementation released processing-1435-4.5.7 on 2026-09-24.

name: Prolog
summary: Prolog expresses relationships as facts and rules and searches for solutions to queries, supporting symbolic reasoning and applications built with logic programming.
lifecycleNote: SWI-Prolog implementation released V10.1.17 on 2026-10-04.

name: Puppet
summary: Puppet's declarative language describes desired resource states in manifests, which the Puppet tools compile and apply to configure machines.
lifecycleNote: Puppet Core 9.1.0 documentation was published on 2026-10-06 and documents its supported manifest language.

name: PureScript
summary: PureScript is a statically typed functional language that compiles to JavaScript, with type inference and an ecosystem for browser and server applications.
lifecycleNote: PureScript implementation released v0.15.16 on 2026-03-15.

name: Python
summary: Python is a dynamically typed language supporting procedural, object-oriented and functional code. Its standard library and package ecosystem serve automation, web development and scientific applications.

links.label: Python FAQ: first public posting in February 1991

lifecycleNote: The Python project announced Python 3.15.0 on 9 October 2026 and maintenance releases earlier that month.
